description: This bar chart illustrates the average performance of two methods, labeled “Standard” and “Ours”, across three categories: an unlabeled category, “CORG”, and “AdaCAD”. The horizontal axis displays the category labels in the order of unlabeled, “CORG”, and “AdaCAD”. The vertical axis, labeled “Average Performance”, presents a linear scale ranging from 48 to 62, with tick marks at intervals of 2. For each category, two bars are presented side-by-side. The “Standard” method is represented by gray bars, while the “Ours” method is represented by blue bars. The “Standard” method achieves approximate performance values of 49 for the unlabeled category, 59 for “CORG”, and 61 for “AdaCAD”. Correspondingly, the “Ours” method achieves approximate performance values of 59 for the unlabeled category, 61 for “CORG”, and 62 for “AdaCAD”. The bars are not visually emphasized beyond their color differentiation, and are arranged in groups corresponding to each category.
